js.home: const cate=env.get("category");const page=env.get("page");const p=Number(page||1);const url=p<=1?(env.baseUrl+"/anime/ai/"):(env.baseUrl+"/anime/ai/page/"+p+"/");const html=await(0,utils_1.req)(url);const out=[];const seen={};const re=/<a[^>]*href="(\/anime\/ai\/(\d+)\/)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g;let m;while((m=re.exec(html))&&out.length<50){const id=m[2];if(seen[id])continue;seen[id]=1;const inner=m[3];const cm=inner.match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/)||inner.match(/src="([^"]*upload[^"]*)"/);const cover=cm?cm[1]:"";const am=inner.match(/alt="([^"]*)"/);let title=am?am[1]:"";if(!title)title=inner.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").trim();if(title&&title.length>1){out.push({id:"/anime/ai/"+id+"/",title,cover,remark:"AI漫剧"})}}return out
